name: Monki Business Remastered
summary:
Welcome to the world of Monki Business!

Swing, climb, and traverse using nothing but your hands in a fast-paced, immersive VR experience. Whether you're playing solo or jumping into lobbies with friends, every room is a chance to explore, compete, and have fun.

Discover a variety of unique maps, each hiding secrets and new experiences waiting to be uncovered. From chaotic chases to relaxed exploration, there’s always something happening in Monki Business.
